limits: Own worker CPU excludes child CPU and does not isolate module import from body execution.
A complete drain within the original budget is one observation; reproducible throughput root cause and stable performance closure remain unproved.
Nested fixture red reports and invalid cost records in cost-observation negative controls are not ordinary outer assertion failures.
